mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT tdm09_appr_step_id AS appr_step_id , tdm09_role_id AS role_id , tdm09_org_id AS org_id , (SELECT tdm20_role_nm FROM tdm20_role WHERE tdm20_role_id = tdm09_role_id) AS role_name , emp01_kor_nm AS exct_name , org00_kor_nm AS org_name , (SELECT f_emp_kor_nm(tdm08_person_id) FROM tdm08_manager_info WHERE tdm08_org_id = tdm09_org_id AND tdm08_manager_type = '21' AND tdm08_start_date <= f_today() AND (tdm08_end_date >= f_today() OR tdm08_end_date IS NULL) LIMIT 1) AS manager_name FROM tdm09_appr_step INNER JOIN getOrg(#{companyId}, f_today()) ON org00_org_id = tdm09_org_id LEFT JOIN getTdm30RoleAllc(#{companyId}, f_today(), false) ON tdm30_role_id = tdm09_role_id LEFT JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = tdm30_person_id WHERE tdm09_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm09_type_cd = 'C' ) t WHERE CONCAT(role_name, org_name, manager_name) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY role_name COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , org_name COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT tdm09_appr_step_id AS appr_step_id , tdm09_appr_seq AS appr_seq , tdm09_appr_emp_id AS appr_emp_id , emp00_kor_nm AS appr_emp_name , emp00_org_code_nm AS appr_org_name , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp00_pos_cd, tdm09_company_id, f_today()) AS pos_name , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm09_appr_seq) || '차 승인자' AS appr_step_info FROM tdm09_appr_step LEFT JOIN getPerson(#{companyId}, f_today()) ON emp00_person_id = tdm09_appr_emp_id WHERE tdm09_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm09_type_cd = 'T' AND tdm09_parent_id = #{apprStepId}

SELECT tdm09_appr_step_id AS appr_step_id , tdm09_company_id AS company_id , tdm09_role_id AS role_id , tdm09_org_id AS org_id , tdm09_type_cd AS type_code FROM tdm09_appr_step WHERE tdm09_appr_step_id = #{apprStepId}

SELECT tdm09_appr_step_id AS appr_step_id , tdm09_role_id AS role_id , tdm09_org_id AS org_id , NULL::varchar AS role_name , NULL::varchar AS exct_name , NULL::varchar AS org_name , NULL::varchar AS manager_name FROM tdm09_appr_step WHERE tdm09_appr_step_id = #{apprStepId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm09_appr_step ( tdm09_appr_step_id, tdm09_company_id, tdm09_role_id, tdm09_org_id, tdm09_type_cd, tdm09_parent_id, tdm09_upd_nm, tdm09_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{apprStepId}, #{companyId}, #{row.roleId}, #{row.orgId}, 'C', 0, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )

INSERT INTO tdm09_appr_step ( tdm09_appr_step_id, tdm09_company_id, tdm09_role_id, tdm09_org_id, tdm09_type_cd, tdm09_parent_id, tdm09_appr_seq, tdm09_appr_emp_id, tdm09_upd_nm, tdm09_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{apprStepId}, #{companyId}, #{roleId}, #{orgId}, 'T', #{parentId}, #{apprSeq}, #{apprEmpId}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
